status: post hoc (WP7, not pre-registered); descriptive; decides no outcome
source: each reporting run's 'verification' field (audit.json: reported.verification), read in full by the analyst

kinds.cuts: electron current summed across channel cuts or boxes (second current measure)
kinds.network: linearized Scharfetter-Gummel network compared with a finite difference or another network form (second current measure)
kinds.contacts: drain and/or source contact currents of the same runs (second current measure; moderate-current task only)
kinds.sheet_density: conductance estimate from the sheet electron density (not a current measure)
